title: Phytochemical Profiling and Mechanistic Evaluation of the Antioxidant and Anti-Inflammatory Activities of Curcuma caesia Roxb. Rhizome Extract: An Integrated In Vitro, In Vivo, and In Silico Study.
authors: Biswas, Anupam; Boruah, Jyoti Lakshmi Hati; Mridha, Prosenjit; Baishya, Rinku
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦姜黄根茎提取物的抗氧化抗炎活性，分子对接仅针对NF-κB等信号通路蛋白，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Curcuma caesia Roxb. (black turmeric) has long been used in Ayurveda and traditional medicine to treat various ailments. Considering the contribution of oxidative stress and inflammation to the development of various diseases, such as cancer, diabetes, and metabolic syndrome, the current study investigated the antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties of C. caesia Roxb. rhizome methanolic extract (CCM), along with phytochemical profiling. Antioxidant activity experiments showed IC(50) values of 66.5 +/- 8.81 microg/mL, 42.69 +/- 5.78 microg/mL, and 132.35 +/- 8.08 microg/mL, for DPPH, ABTS, and metal chelating assay, respectively. In the in vivo study, antioxidant and inflammatory mediator expression was evaluated, where the levels of TNF-alpha, IL-6, ALT, AST, and iNOS, were reduced, and IL-10 and SOD were increased significantly at high dose. Phytochemical characterization by UPLC-ESI-HRMS tentatively annotated curcumenol, curzerenone, furanogerenone, and germacrone as major compounds and zederone as a minor trace constituent. Molecular docking analysis was performed by targeting NF-kappaB, ERK, p38, JNK, and Nrf2 pathways, where docking scores ranged from -5.5 to -8.6 kcal/mol. Overall, these findings provide the mechanistic insights into the interconnection between the antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects of CCM, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic agent against oxidative stress and inflammation-associated diseases.
abstract_zh: Curcuma caesia Roxb.（黑姜黄）长期以来在阿育吠陀和传统医学中被用于治疗多种疾病。鉴于氧化应激和炎症在癌症、糖尿病及代谢综合征等多种疾病发展中的贡献，本研究探讨了C. caesia Roxb.根茎甲醇提取物（CCM）的抗氧化和抗炎特性，并进行了植物化学分析。抗氧化活性实验显示，DPPH、ABTS和金属螯合测定的IC(50)值分别为66.5 ± 8.81微克/毫升、42.69 ± 5.78微克/毫升和132.35 ± 8.08微克/毫升。在体内研究中，评估了抗氧化和炎症介质的表达，其中TNF-α、IL-6、ALT、AST和iNOS的水平降低，而IL-10和SOD在高剂量下显著增加。通过UPLC-ESI-HRMS进行的植物化学表征初步注释了姜黄烯醇、莪术烯酮、呋喃吉马酮和吉马酮为主要化合物，而泽地黄酮为微量成分。分子对接分析针对NF-kappaB、ERK、p38、JNK和Nrf2通路进行，对接分数范围为-5.5至-8.6 kcal/mol。总体而言，这些发现为CCM的抗氧化和抗炎效应之间的相互联系提供了机制性见解，突显其作为对抗氧化应激和炎症相关疾病的治疗剂的潜力。
